title: Clipsal Australia Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Dataletta Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Clipsal Australia Pty Ltd (Clipsal) entered into an agreement with Dataletta Pty Ltd (Dataletta) under which it would wholly acquire Dataletta.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition to be in the market for commercial lighting control.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the market for commercial lighting control.  In reaching this view the ACCC noted that there is an ongoing threat of entry into the market, a number of substitutable products available and large customers which are likely to have a sufficient degree of countervailing power.  Further, the ACCC noted the potential for new entrants to take advantage of the growing market.
